elements.name: Keep Recent table formatting uniform and readable during window resize

steps.name: the Home workspace is active with recent documents in List View
the user narrows or shortens the main application window
every visible row formats Date Modified and Last Opened using the same date format for that width
filenames remain readable without collapsing columns into empty slivers
the scrolled list keeps bottom clearance so the last visible row is not clipped behind the document tab strip
